Subject: RE: Renewal & expansion call — usage review and next steps

Hi Samir / Elena,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great discussion. Below is a short recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned heading into the renewal.

Quick recap of what we heard:
- Current usage: ~1.2M generation tokens/day (spikes to 1.8M), 150k embeddings/month (search + personalization).
- Primary pain points:
  - Latency for search hits critical SLAs (95th percentile ~380ms currently).
  - Embedding cost is the largest line item for the personalization workload.
  - Onboarding complexity for the new summarization pipeline (high token lengths, KV caching requirements).
- Goals for next 12 months:
  1) Reduce embedding unit cost by ~30% (target).
  2) Ensure sub-200ms 95th latency for search route.
  3) Launch summarization workload (QA, infra, and rollout plan) in Q4.

Proposed expansion/upsell path we discussed:
- Short term: Add Dedicated reserved capacity for batch embedding jobs + Optimize consult to tune batching and quantization. Estimated 2-3 months to see unit-cost improvements.
- Mid term: Migrate high-throughput search route to a low-latency Dedicated pool with prefix caching and tuned kernels (we’ll provide target SLOs and perf plan).
- Contract: We discussed a 12-month renewal with a committed GPU capacity add-on (details in SOW draft).

Action items / owners / dates:
- Marissa (me): Share usage export, draft SOW, and ballpark pricing by EOD Jul 25. (attachments: 2026-07-20-usage-report.xlsx, SOW-draft-v1.pdf)
- Logan: Provide 2 pricing tiers (conservative and aggressive) + brief note on expected cost delta by Jul 24.
- Dev: Scope technical onboarding and quantization plan for summarization workload; rough timeline and dependencies by Jul 24.
- Samir / Elena: Confirm timelines and any procurement constraints (PO lead time, security sign-off) — reply by Jul 23 if possible.

Next meeting: Pricing & SOW review — propose Jul 27 or Jul 28 afternoon PT. I’ll send a calendar invite once I hear which slot works.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
